# Launcher 2.9.1 (the release) on a Cheap Yellow Display 2432S028, as its serial console printed it

Read through the board's broker, the second Launcher board the family read. `version.txt`,
`partitions.txt` as printed; `settings_get.txt` with the WebUI password replaced by
`example-only`, the chip's MAC (which keys one entry, with Launcher's name for the board type)
by an example MAC, and the saved network's name by `example-net`. What it shows beside the
T-Embed's: the 2.9.1 release answers `version` too; one app installed, selected, in `ota_0`
right after Launcher's own partition; 4 MB of flash with the free range printed.
